request.spec:
A person may name other people on the sheet as their patrons, one at a time from their row (not
themselves, and not the same person twice; a refusal shows an error on the row; PATRON_ADDED
name=<name> patron=<patron name>). Show each person's patrons (names, comma and space separated,
sorted) and their backing: their patrons' due-totals added up, skipping n/a, 0.00 with no
patrons.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A person may name other people on the sheet as their patrons, one at a time from their row (not
themselves, and not the same person twice; a refusal shows an error on the row; PATRON_ADDED
name=<name> patron=<patron name>). Show each person's patrons (names, comma and space separated,
sorted) and their backing: their patrons' due-totals added up, skipping n/a, 0.00 with no
patrons.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Patrons and backing are working, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

**How it works**
- Each person's row now has a patron dropdown and an "Add patron" button. The dropdown lists everyone else on the sheet, so a person can't pick themselves.
- The server refuses a person as their own patron, the same patron twice, or a patron who isn't on the sheet. A refusal shows an error on the row, saves nothing and writes nothing to the audit file. Choosing in the dropdown or pressing the button again clears the error.
- Each successful add writes `PATRON_ADDED sheet=… by=… name=<person> patron=<patron>` to the audit file.
- Two new columns on each row:
  - **Patrons:** the names, comma and space separated, sorted ignoring case.
  - **Backing:** the patrons' due-totals added up, skipping n/a, and 0.00 with no patrons. It's worked out on the screen from the same due-totals the rows already show, so it follows holds, rate changes and other changes to those totals.

**What changed**
- **Stored data:** a new `person_patron` table in migration `V20__person_patron.sql`.
- **Server:** a new endpoint, `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/people/{personId}/patrons`, handled by `ValidatePatron` and `AddPatron`. Each person returned by the server now also carries `patrons` (sorted names) and `patronIds`.
- **Front end:** a new `PatronControl.tsx`, plus the two columns in `PeopleList.tsx`.

Retired people still appear in the patron dropdown. The request didn't say whether they should, so I left them in.
